findings.text: The 02:11:56 PASS entry records p3_moment_bound v1.0 with binary_hash 8e5c8c5d32... which matches no certification record (claims/verifiers.json certifies v1.0 only as 53eacdb425..., stamped 02:39:17), predates that stamp by ~27 minutes, and carries null provenance (argv=None cwd=None exit=None env_sha256=None). The label 'v1.0' thus denotes two distinct binaries in the record, and only the 02:40:45 entry satisfies 'a certificate that a certified verifier replays with PASS'. [Evidence entry claims/evidence/p3_moment/k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json -> PASS at 2026-10-27T02:11:56+00:00 (binary_hash 8e5c8c5d...) vs claims/verifiers.json certification record (binary_hash 53eacdb4..., stamped 2026-10-27T02:39:17+00:00)]

machine_checked item (b) discloses 'two polynomial identities' for 'every output mode i (m = 5) and Bell pair (B, B')' — 160 identities over ordered pairs (100 over unordered) — while the certified replay reports checking 80. No counting convention stated in the evidence reconciles the disclosed machine-checked boundary with the replayed count, so what the certified verifier actually replayed is not pinned down by the disclosure. [Evidence entry note at 02:40:45 pack verifier detail '80 identities; bound 2/3' vs k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json about.machine_checked (b)]

The bound statement text never defines p_B or the discrimination ensemble: 'acting on the dual-rail Bell pair' is a definite singular, while '(1/4) sum_B p_B' presupposes the input ranges over the four Bell states with p_B = Pr[pattern assigned to B | input B]. That reading is supplied only by the evidence file's setting field ('p_B = sum over patterns mapped to B of Pr[pattern | B]'), which lies outside the exact text the receipt binds to. [Statement phrases 'the average success (1/4) sum_B p_B' and 'acting on the dual-rail Bell pair'; definition only in k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json about.setting]

The identification of A_B(n) with the physical amplitude <n|out_B> rests on domain/p3/poly.py bell_amp_poly, whose claimed cross-validation ('both float engines', tests/test_p3_poly_k1.py) is in an external test file that is neither an evidence entry nor a written step; machine checks (I1)/(I2) verify relations among the computed polynomials, not the physics encoding itself. Otherwise the evidence does carry the universal claim: (b)'s identities are exact over Q in free entries of U (covering all of U(5) once W1 substitutes U^dag U = I), W2 covers every unambiguous assignment, and about.claim_statement matches the ledger statement verbatim. [k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json about.machine_checked (b): 'bell_amp_poly (cross-validated against both float engines by tests/test_p3_poly_k1.py)' and about.claim_statement]

Checked verbatim match of lemma_certificate.statement against the dependency P3.one_body_usd_lemma statement; the objective {sA:-1, sB:-1, c:-4, lam_*:+1} with bound 0 over variables [sA(8), sB(9), c(10), lam_phi+/-, lam_psi+/- (11-14)] encodes sum_B lambda_B <= s_A + s_B + 4c as stated; gate (a) plus golden case moment-k1-m5-foreign-lemma (expects FAIL) pin the embedded certificate to that exact lemma. Mode indexing is coherent throughout (qubit A columns 0-1, qubit B columns 2-3, c_i = |U_i4|^2 matching 'input mode 4, 0-indexed'). [k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json lemma_certificate.statement/.objective/.variables vs dependency P3.one_body_usd_lemma; golden suite case moment-k1-m5-foreign-lemma]

The operator-theoretic core is written-only (W2 Bell-diagonality from the zero-probability clause, W3 transpose-vs-real-diagonal PSD step, W4 rank-one O_A = conj(u)u^T including the u = 0 edge case, W5 three-photon count, W6 column sums 2+2+4 = 8 giving average <= 2/3), which CERTIFIED permits since the boundary is disclosed in written_steps; I re-derived each step against the lemma's hypothesis format (W W^dagger, real lambda_B, unit a, b) and found no error. Gate (c) 'claimed_p_avg_bound >= (1 + 1)/(1 + 2)' equals the claimed 2/3 and golden case moment-k1-m5-bound-too-low (FAIL) guards the direction; the Notes correctly avoid a tightness overclaim ('the bound is not tight'). [k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json about.written_steps W1-W6; about.machine_checked (c); Notes field 'the bound is not tight']

The dependency cap is satisfied (sole dependency P3.one_body_usd_lemma is CERTIFIED, standing CURRENT, so promotion to CERTIFIED does not exceed the lowest dependency level) and sequencing is coherent: the 02:40:45 certified replay postdates verifier certification (02:39:17). Promotion is deferred only by the three warnings above (uncertified-binary PASS entry under the v1.0 label, identity-count disclosure mismatch, undefined p_B/ensemble in the bound text), not by any structural obstacle.
